hard_rules: A nested archive whose own manifest declares physical_authority_change=false cannot supersede the enclosing physical authority.
A nested artifact named CURRENT_* is historical when its enclosing object is explicitly a historical/recovery overlay.
Recursive recovery must compare authority generation/snapshot identity before accepting any CURRENT_* pointer.
If top-level manifest/trust-root and nested CURRENT_* disagree, top-level sealed authority wins and nested content remains provenance-only.
Do not rewrite or delete nested historical evidence solely to remove the ambiguity.
